# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- For this project, the user requires screens to strictly follow the provided mock UI design references.
- Implement floating label entry as a common reusable control to be used across screens throughout the app.
- Use shared/common styling resources (centralized constants, styles, and colors) for login/auth UI instead of page-level inline values.
- Ensure swipe button background/progress colors remain visually pleasant during and after swipe, avoiding harsh color shifts.
